title: Stomp
description:
Deal 12 damage to ALL enemies.
Costs 1 less Energy for each Attack played this turn.
upgraded_description:
Deal 15 damage to ALL enemies.
Costs 1 less Energy for each Attack played this turn.
notes: When Stomp enters combat, its cost is reduced by the number of Attacks already played this turn. Before each Attack card is played, Stomp's cost is also reduced by 1, allowing it to become cheaper as the turn progresses.
